title: 2004 AMC 12A Problem 5
statement: The graph of a line \(y = mx + b\) is shown. Which of the following is true?

solutions.text:
The \(y\)-intercept of the line is between \(0\) and \(1,\) so \(0 \lt b \lt 1.\)

The slope is negative and shallow, between \(-1\) and \(0,\) so \(-1 \lt m \lt 0.\)

The product \(mb\) is therefore negative with absolute value less than \(1,\) giving \(-1 \lt mb \lt 0.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: Read the sign and size of the slope \(m\) and the \(y\)-intercept \(b\) separately
Both \(m\) and \(b\) have absolute value less than \(1,\) but opposite signs
